## Summary

Describe the change and the reason for it.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / maintenance
- [ ] Security

## Verification

- [ ] I tested the affected behavior.
- [ ] I ran relevant checks (for frontend changes, `npm run build` in `front-end/`).
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for secrets, credentials, and unrelated changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation where needed.

## Screenshots (for UI changes)

Add before/after screenshots if they help reviewers understand the change. Remove personal information and sensitive data.

## Notes

List any known limitations, configuration changes, or follow-up work.
